note: G5 behaviour check (HYPOTHESIS Phase 0, BUILD_SPEC 5.3): 20 short factual or one-step prompts, 10 EN and 10 DE, written by Claude for exp_036 and frozen in the gate code hash. Each is sent as a single user turn through the vendor template at effort high (cap 8,192 tokens) and at effort none. Only loops, a missing EOS, lang_tag 'unknown' and the think format are checked; the answers are never scored. Version 2 (integration, 2026-10-03): every prompt asks for two complete sentences, because scorers/lang_tag.py needs at least two function words and returns 'unknown' for a correct one-word or number-only answer, which the blocking rule (>= 2/20 'unknown') would count.
